title: Maestría en Métodos para el Análisis de Políticas Públicas (METPOL)
institution: Centro de Investigación y Docencia Económicas (CIDE)
about: CIDE's 2027 call for its Master's in Methods for Public Policy Analysis (METPOL) accepts registrations from 4 September 2026 to 15 February 2027 for applicants sitting exams at an embassy, consulate or SECIHTI site, and to 24 February 2027 at CIDE sites.
requirements: Applicants may apply to only one programme per call
Admission stages end on the dates set in the call, with no extensions

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations II
why: Field "Public policy analysis methods" → "Apply causal inference and experimental-design principles through A/B testing, randomized controlled trials, and quasi-experimental approaches to distinguish correlation from causal effects."
